tags.description: The Buca palace is situated opposite to the palace Pima. Today’s look of this palace does not depict the historical importance of the family Buca, one of the most eminent families in Kotor

tags.description: Hotel Cattaro is situated in a perfect location, in the heart of a medieval, seaside town- Kotor. It is located in the town's main square, also occupying the part of the town walls, so-called Citadel, where you can find the discotheque Maximus and...

tags.description: It was built in the 18th century. Together with the Tower of the town’s guard it makes almost all eastern façade of the town. In the past it was an official seat of the Venetian providures. It served for various military purposes
tags.name: Kneževa (Providurova) palata

tags.description: The Tower of Town Guards, the lean-to the Duke’s Palace, is an evident example of military architecture – built to serve the military purpose only. It was built of high-quality stone against the interior side of western wall.
tags.name: Kula gradske straže

tags.description: he Palace Bizanti with one façade is turned to Square of Arms and with the other overlooking the street leading to Square of Flour. It was built in the fourteenth century.
tags.name: Palata Bizanti

tags.name: Crkva Svete Klare / Svetog Antuna

tags.description: The Pima Palace, built after the 1667 earthquake, dominates the square with its beauty. The palace portal with the terrace was built in the Renaissance style while the windows and upper balcony which lies on the twelve consoles were built in the Baroque..
tags.name: Palata Pima

tags.description: The palace Grgurina belonged to the noble family Grgurina. It was built in the eighteenth century in the Baroque style, with the façade on which dominate stone balconies with balustrades
tags.name: Palata Grgurina
